D = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142], favoring the fixed rule. L5a and L5c confirm this for the shipped allocator. Claim 3: E10 (OLMo-2 1B, a different model from E01) has embedding AUC gain -0.002 and cell100 neighbor ratio 0.998, which meets the kill rule.
